about: Slideshow image rules for core/skills/image-prompt/check.py --rules. Each rule restates a house rule from sections/slideshows/rules.md by its ID; rules.md is the home of the rule and its full reason.

rules.why: no Apple Watch or smartwatch anywhere; a watch named in the scene ends up in the image
generators add a watch to wrists by default, so every prompt with a person excludes it
a visible phone always has a case; a bare phone reads as a render
keep natural real branding; blanket no-logo scenes look staged. Only invented, garbled or added text may be excluded
